ArrivalPxOffset.NAME: ArrivalPxOffset
ArrivalPxOffset.DESCRIPTION: Offset from arrival price in basis points (positive = above, negative = below)

Urgency.NAME: Urgency
Urgency.DESCRIPTION: Controls the speed/risk trade-off when tracking arrival price

MaxDeviation.NAME: MaxDeviation
MaxDeviation.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed deviation from arrival price as a percentage

AllowMomentum.NAME: AllowMomentum
AllowMomentum.DESCRIPTION: Allow momentum-based opportunistic fills beyond the arrival price
